unit: one selected edition per canonical publication/body component

identity_fields.source_id: Stable selected publication/body component, inherited for old records
identity_fields.publication_id: Source-issued publication identifier when inherited; otherwise SHA256 of canonical individual URL
identity_fields.selected_edition_id: One selected text edition per source_id
identity_fields.recording_id: SHA256 of encoded media bytes; encoding identity, not semantic recording equivalence
identity_fields.channel_id: Publisher context; not necessarily a YouTube account
identity_fields.creator_id: Source-attributed medium/context, including mixed-speaker guest contexts
identity_fields.claimed_label: Source attribution; does not prove an entity exists or is shared across mediums

null_policy: Unknown, absent join or unmeasured; never impute zero from null
text_normalization: Unicode NFKC, outer whitespace stripped; no internal whitespace/case change
deduplication: Existing frozen components retained; new individual OmNa article URLs join only after whitespace-folded body equality. All original edition hashes retained. Similarity alone never merges identities.
public_body_policy: No full corpus bodies or private filesystem paths in public output
